name: CreateOrUpdateContact
label: Create or Update Salesforce Contact
description: Creates a new Contact in Salesforce if it doesn't exist, or updates it if it does. Uses Email as the identifier.

fields.name: Credential
fields.label: Credential to Connect With
fields.description: The Salesforce connection credential to use for authentication.

fields.name: Email
fields.label: Email
fields.description: The email address of the Contact (used as lookup key). Required for update. Optional for create.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.label: First Name
fields.description: The first name of the Contact (required).

fields.name: LastName
fields.label: Last Name
fields.description: The last name of the Contact (required).

fields.name: AdditionalFields
fields.label: Additional Fields
fields.description: Optional additional fields such as Phone, Title, Department, etc.

fields.name: ContactId
fields.label: Created or Updated Contact ID
fields.description: The Salesforce ID of the Contact after creation or update.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: The raw JSON response returned by Salesforce after the operation.
